REGULAR MEETING OF THE BALDWIN PARK RECREATION AND
  COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK,
  Council Chambers
  Tuesday, July 5, 2016
  5:10 p.m.

The meeting was Called to Order at 5:10pm, by Chair Person Watkins.

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Ayala.

ROLL CALL:  Commissioners Jean Ayala, Madeline Gutierrez, Deanna Robles,
  Christopher Saenz, and Watkins.

ABSENT :  Anthony Grijalva and Luz Mercado

ALSO PRESENT: Manuel Carrillo Jr., Director of Recreation and Community Services,
  Vanessa Carbajal Program Coordinator, Angela Alvarado Program
  Specialist and Teresa Alexander Commission Secretary

REGULAR MEETING OF THE BALDWIN PARK  July 5, 2016
RECREATION AND COMMUNITY SERVICES
COMMISSION
 REPORTS OF OFFICERS, COMMISSIONERS OR COMMITTEES

  1. Program Coordinator Vanessa Carbajal – Staff Introduction

Program Coordinator Vanessa Carbajal introduced herself to the Recreation
Commission. Vanessa Carbajal has worked with the City of Baldwin Park for 18 years.
She started as a part time staff in sports and then became a program specialist at the
Community Center. Vanessa became full time 9 year ago and began supervising the
Arts and Recreation Building and for the past 4 and a half years has been supervising
the Baldwin Park Teen Center and Skate Park. Vanessa has a Master’s in Public
Administration from the University of La Verne and Bachelors in visual communication
and Associates in graphic design. Vanessa also over sees special events and special
projects within the Recreation department and Community Development. She has also
been on the board for the California Parks and Recreation Society (CPRS) District 13
for the past 10 years. Vanessa has served as a Member at Large, Communications
Officer, Vice President, President and currently holding the Past President title. CPRS
organizes trainings for the recreation staff to help improve their recreation skills in the
“Parks” world. It can be anything from water conservancies, the latest fad with teens to
seniors.

  2. July Parks and Recreation Month

Manuel Carrillo Jr., Director of Recreation and Community Services shared with the
commission the importance of July Parks and Recreation month. July is known as
Parks and Recreation month across the United States. Recreation departments around
the US celebrate by designating a day in the month of July that their city can celebrate
and thank the Recreation Staff. Baldwin Park will observe July Parks and Recreation
month on Thursday, July 14th at the Selena Tribute Concert. We will celebrate with a
department photo at 6:40pm right before the summer concert. Mayor Lozano and the
City Council will present a proclamation to the department. Following the department
photo at 7:00pm will be dinner in the Senior Center celebration Hall along with a gift a
raffle prizes for part time staff. All of the Recreation staff is invited to attend the
department photo and dinner. The department photo will be displayed on the City’s
website as well as the Baldwin Park TV channel.

  3. Pride of the Valley 5K Run Update

Program Coordinator will give the Commission an update regarding the Pride of the
  th
Valley 5K Run that will take place on Saturday, August 6 . The tike trot will start at 7:30
am and the 5K Run Walk will start at 8:00am. Registration has started and the prices
are as follows; $20 for the run only, $25 for run w/t-shirt, $10 for tike trot (run only) and
$15 tike trot w/t-shirt. Late registration will start after July 8th. Add $5 to all fees. The
high school that have the most participants will win a 10 X 10 canopy. In the past, Great
REGULAR MEETING OF THE BALDWIN PARK  July 5, 2016
RECREATION AND COMMUNITY SERVICES
COMMISSION
 Oak high school in Jurupa, have had the most runners with the best times. This race
brings runners from as far south as San Diego and as far north as Valencia. This year
we have changes the layout of the flyer to a small post card to make it easier to pass
out and promote. We have a lot of runners that like to come and compete with other
runners in their age group to be the highest time. Since 2007/08 we have had a steady
increase of runners that have crossed the finish line. Vanessa’s goal this year is to have
1,000 runners cross the finish line. Last year we got close but fell short, we had 823
runners that crossed the finish line. We had over 1,000 registered runners last year but
not all of them finished or attended the run. The logo for the Pride of the Valley run is a
play on the City’s 60th logo, with the colorful diamonds. The top runners will receive a
60th commemorative medal in gold, silver or bronze. Within the City of Baldwin Park we
have a contest between Baldwin Park High School and Sierra Vista High School called
the Mayors cup. It is determined on how many participants there are and what the best
times. The trophy has gone back in forth but the last 2 years Baldwin Park High School
has won. We do not break any rules within the CIF contracts and guidelines. There will
be numerous vendors that will be participating. We have a nutrition shop, a foot doctor,
and chiropractors. Evel will be donating 1,000 breakfast burritos to the runners. We are
encouraging the commissioners to attend the run and help with registration or handing
out water or snacks to the runners. The commissioners are encouraged to arrive by
6/6:30am.

  4. Movies on the Green Update

Program Specialist Angela Alvarado gave the commission an update regarding the
Movies on the Green that will start on Friday, July 8th at Barnes Park Family Recreation
Center at 8pm. The first movie will be “Hotel Transylvania” There will be snacks and
games in a family fun zone. It is a great place to take the family of all ages. These
FREE movies will be every Friday in the month of July and will conclude on Friday,
August 5th with the Minions movie. All of the movies are PG family friendly movies.

  5. Shop Baldwin Park Campaign

Director of Recreation and Community Services Director Manuel Carrillo gave the
Commission an update regarding the Shop Baldwin Park Campaign. Since the
Recreation Department is overseeing the Community Development Department we are
organizing a shop Baldwin Park Campaign. We are in the process of finalizing the
billboard and promotional material. We would like to remind the residents how important
it is to shop in Baldwin Park. Not only are you supporting local business but you are
keeping the tax dollars in Baldwin Park. We are in the process of opening other
businesses in the LA Fitness parking lot. It is still tentative as to which restaurants will
open. Commission Saenz asked how the shuttle service has been working out for the
summer concerts. Program Specialist Angela Alvarado shared with the Commission
that there were a few people that used the shuttle service and really enjoyed it. We
REGULAR MEETING OF THE BALDWIN PARK  July 5, 2016
RECREATION AND COMMUNITY SERVICES
COMMISSION
 have a lot of signage at Morgan Park promoting it as well as here at the parking
structure. Director of Recreation Manuel Carrillo Jr., shared with the Commission that
he rented a digital board to promote the concert and he is looking in to renting another
one for the shuttle parking. He also walked around the park and asked people how
parking was and they shared that parking was not an issue. They were able to find
parking easy.

Commission Requests and Communications

Vanessa Carbajal shared with the Commission the ribbon cutting ceremony that will be
taking place on Thursday, July 7th at the Grocery Outlet Bargain Market located on
Maine. The store will open at 8am and the ribbon cutting ceremony will start at 9:00am
and lunch will be provided by Taco Nazo following the ribbon cutting. There will be an
actual grand opening on Saturday July 9th at 8am.

Commissioner Ayala wanted to thank Manny and the Department for all of their hard
work at the first concert and for the 4th of July event.

Commissioner Robles wanted to know if there is anything that the department can do to
start programs for children and adults with special needs. She is willing to help in any
way that she can. Manuel Carrillo Jr., will speak to Armando Nava and will look in to it.

Commissioner Saenz thanked the department for all of their hard work. He enjoyed the
concert and the 4th of July event.

Student Commissioner Gutierrez thanked the department for their hard work. She
enjoyed the 4th of July event.

Chair Person Watkins thanked the department for always going above and beyond at
everything they do.

ADJOURNMENT

With no other business being presented, it was motioned and seconded to adjourn the
meeting at 5:45pm M/S/C: ROBLES/SAENZ/WATKINS
